  have h2 : 1001 * 1001 * 1001 ≤ k * k * k := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul hk hk) hk
  have h3 : k ^ 4 = k * k * k * k := by simp [Nat.pow_succ]
  rw [h3]
  have h4 : 1001 * 1001 * 1001 * k ≤ k * k * k * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_right k h2
  omega
